userStories.story: As a user, I want to sign in with my userid and password so that I can access the CardDemo application
userStories.trigger: Enter userid and password, press Enter key
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates credentials against USRSEC file and routes to admin menu (COADM01C) or user menu (COMEN01C) based on user type

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to select from the admin menu options so that I can access administrative functions
userStories.trigger: Enter option number (1-7), press Enter key
userStories.expectedBehavior: Routes to selected program based on option: 1-Account, 2-Credit Card, 3-Transaction, 4-Bill Payment, 5-User, 6-Reports, 7-Authorization

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to sign off from the admin menu so that I can end my session securely
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to sign-on screen (COSGN00C) and ends the user session

userStories.story: As a regular user, I want to select from the user menu options so that I can access available functions
userStories.trigger: Enter option number (1-4), press Enter key
userStories.expectedBehavior: Routes to selected program based on option: 1-Account, 2-Credit Card, 3-Transaction, 4-Bill Payment

userStories.story: As a regular user, I want to sign off from the user menu so that I can end my session securely
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to sign-on screen (COSGN00C) and ends the user session

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view account details by entering an account ID so that I can see account information
userStories.trigger: Enter account ID, press Enter key
userStories.expectedBehavior: Reads ACCTDAT file and displays account details including ID, status, balance, credit limit, and associated customer information
validationStates: Account ID can NOT be empty

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to the previous menu from account view so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to previous menu (admin menu or user menu based on context)
dependencies: CICS XCTL to COADM01C or COMEN01C

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to update account information so that I can maintain accurate customer data
userStories.trigger: Enter account ID, modify fields (address, city, state, zip, phone, credit limit), press PF5 to update
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates input fields and updates ACCTDAT file with new account information
validationStates: Account ID can NOT be empty
Phone number must be valid US format

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to clear the update form so that I can start fresh with a different account
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears all input fields and resets the form to initial state

userStories.story: As a user, I want to search for a credit card by card number so that I can view its details
userStories.trigger: Enter card number, press Enter key
userStories.expectedBehavior: Searches CARDDAT file and displays card details if found
validationStates: Card number can NOT be empty

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to the previous menu from card search so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to previous menu (admin menu or user menu)
dependencies: CICS XCTL to COADM01C or COMEN01C

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view a paginated list of credit cards so that I can browse available cards
userStories.trigger: Press Enter key or navigate pages
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays 10 cards per page from CARDDAT file. Admin users see all cards, regular users see only cards for their account

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate to the next page of cards so that I can view more cards
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the next 10 cards in the list

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate to the previous page of cards so that I can view earlier cards
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the previous 10 cards in the list

userStories.story: As a user, I want to select a card from the list so that I can view or update its details
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number next to a card, press Enter
userStories.expectedBehavior: Routes to card detail or update screen with selected card number
dependencies: CICS XCTL to COCRDSLC or COCRDUPC

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to update credit card information so that I can maintain accurate card data
userStories.trigger: Enter card number and account ID, modify fields (cardholder name, status, expiry date), press PF5 to update
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates input fields and updates CARDDAT file with new card information
validationStates: Card number can NOT be empty
Card status must be Y or N

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to clear the card update form so that I can start fresh with a different card
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears all input fields and resets the form to initial state

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view a paginated list of transactions so that I can browse transaction history
userStories.trigger: Press Enter key or navigate pages
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays 10 transactions per page from TRANSACT file with transaction ID, card number, date, amount, and merchant

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate to the next page of transactions so that I can view more transactions
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the next 10 transactions in the list

userStories.story: As a user, I want to navigate to the previous page of transactions so that I can view earlier transactions
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the previous 10 transactions in the list

userStories.story: As a user, I want to select a transaction from the list so that I can view its full details
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number next to a transaction, press Enter
userStories.expectedBehavior: Routes to transaction detail screen (COTRN01C) with selected transaction ID

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to the previous menu from transaction list so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to user menu (COMEN01C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to view detailed information for a specific transaction so that I can see all transaction details
userStories.trigger: Enter transaction ID, press Enter key
userStories.expectedBehavior: Reads TRANSACT file and displays complete transaction details including ID, card number, type, category, source, amount, merchant info, and processing date
validationStates: Tran ID can NOT be empty

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the transaction view form so that I can search for a different transaction
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears the transaction ID field and results, allowing a new search

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to the transaction list from transaction detail so that I can browse other transactions
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to transaction list screen (COTRN00C)

userStories.story: As a user, I want to return to the previous menu from transaction detail so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to previous menu or transaction list based on context
dependencies: CICS XCTL to COMEN01C or COTRN00C

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to add a new transaction so that I can record a transaction in the system
userStories.trigger: Fill in transaction fields (card number, type ID, category code, source, description, amount, merchant), press Enter to submit
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates all input fields and writes new transaction record to TRANSACT file with generated transaction ID
validationStates: Card number can NOT be empty
Amount must be greater than zero

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to clear the add transaction form so that I can start fresh with a new transaction
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears all input fields and resets the form to initial state

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the previous menu from add transaction so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to admin menu without saving

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to view a paginated list of system users so that I can browse user accounts
userStories.trigger: Press Enter key or navigate pages
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays 10 users per page from USRSEC file with user ID, name, and user type

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to navigate to the next page of users so that I can view more user accounts
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the next 10 users in the list

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to navigate to the previous page of users so that I can view earlier user accounts
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the previous 10 users in the list

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to select a user from the list so that I can view, update, or delete that user
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number next to a user, press Enter
userStories.expectedBehavior: Routes to user detail, update, or delete screen based on context
dependencies: CICS XCTL to COUSR02C or COUSR03C

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the admin menu from user list so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to admin menu (COADM01C)

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to add a new user account so that new users can access the system
userStories.trigger: Fill in user fields (first name, last name, user ID, password, user type), press Enter to submit
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates all input fields and writes new user record to USRSEC file
validationStates: User Type must be R or A

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to clear the add user form so that I can start fresh with a new user
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears all input fields and resets the form to initial state

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the admin menu from add user so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to admin menu without saving

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to update an existing user account so that I can maintain accurate user information
userStories.trigger: Enter user ID, modify fields (first name, last name, password, user type), press PF5 or PF3 to update
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates input fields and updates USRSEC file with modified user information
validationStates: User ID can NOT be empty
User type must be R or A

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to clear the update user form so that I can start fresh with a different user
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears all input fields and resets the form to initial state

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the admin menu from update user so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to admin menu

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to delete a user account so that I can remove users who no longer need access
userStories.trigger: Enter user ID to delete, press PF5 to confirm deletion
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates user ID exists and deletes the user record from USRSEC file
validationStates: User ID can NOT be empty

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to clear the delete user form so that I can start fresh with a different user
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears the user ID field and resets the form

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to cancel the delete operation so that I can return without deleting
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to admin menu or user list without deleting

userStories.story: As a user, I want to pay my account balance in full so that I can settle my outstanding balance
userStories.trigger: Enter account ID and confirm payment amount, press Enter to process
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates account exists, creates payment transaction in TRANSACT file, and updates account balance in ACCTDAT file
validationStates: Account ID can NOT be empty

userStories.story: As a user, I want to cancel the bill payment so that I can return without processing payment
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to previous menu without processing payment
dependencies: CICS XCTL to COADM01C or COMEN01C

userStories.story: As a user, I want to clear the bill payment form so that I can start fresh with a different account
userStories.expectedBehavior: Clears all input fields and resets the form to initial state

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to generate a transaction report for a date range so that I can analyze transaction activity
userStories.trigger: Enter start date and end date in YYYY-MM-DD format, press Enter to submit batch job
userStories.expectedBehavior: Validates date format and range, submits batch job to extra partition TDQ to generate transaction report
validationStates: Start date must be before end date
Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the admin menu from reports so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to admin menu

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to view a summary list of pending authorization messages so that I can monitor authorization activity
userStories.trigger: Press Enter key or navigate pages
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays 5 authorization messages per page from IMS database with card number, amount, date, time, merchant, and approval status

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to navigate to the next page of authorization messages so that I can view more messages
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the next 5 authorization messages in the list

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to navigate to the previous page of authorization messages so that I can view earlier messages
userStories.expectedBehavior: Displays the previous 5 authorization messages in the list

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to select an authorization message from the list so that I can view its details
userStories.trigger: Enter selection number next to an authorization, press Enter
userStories.expectedBehavior: Routes to authorization detail screen (COPAUS1C) with selected authorization key

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the main menu from authorization summary so that I can navigate back
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to user menu (COMEN01C)

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to view detailed information for a specific authorization message so that I can see all authorization details
userStories.trigger: Enter authorization key or navigate from summary list
userStories.expectedBehavior: Reads IMS database and displays complete authorization details including card number, amount, date, time, merchant information, processing codes, response codes, and decline reasons

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to mark an authorization as fraudulent so that I can flag suspicious activity
userStories.trigger: Press PF5 key to report fraud
userStories.expectedBehavior: Calls COPAUS2C program to insert fraud record into DB2 AUTHFRDS table with fraud flag

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to remove fraud flag from an authorization so that I can correct false fraud reports
userStories.trigger: Press PF6 key to remove fraud flag
userStories.expectedBehavior: Calls COPAUS2C program to update fraud record in DB2 AUTHFRDS table to remove fraud flag

userStories.story: As an administrator, I want to return to the authorization summary from detail so that I can view other authorizations
userStories.expectedBehavior: Returns to authorization summary screen (COPAUS0C)

userStories.story: As the system, I want to record fraud reports in the database so that fraudulent authorizations are tracked
userStories.trigger: Called from COPAUS1C with authorization data and fraud action flag
userStories.expectedBehavior: Inserts new fraud record into DB2 AUTHFRDS table or updates existing record with fraud flag (F) and current date

userStories.story: As the system, I want to remove fraud flags from the database so that corrected authorizations are properly tracked
userStories.trigger: Called from COPAUS1C with authorization data and remove fraud action flag
userStories.expectedBehavior: Updates fraud record in DB2 AUTHFRDS table to remove fraud flag (R) and set current date
